description: Interactions the latency gate drives in the served s shell: the input, its target and the bounds the measurement is judged by. Input → end of the first frame after it; paints = renderFrame calls of the canvas session classes (wasm bindings and host elements) during the gesture; a scenario whose paints could not be hooked fails. A highlighted editor (trinity jack) paints each key twice by design — the local edit, then the guest's re-highlighted echo — plus the caret cadence (2 per second) inside the measured window.
